channel.title: What Is Being Built — Daily Activity Feed
channel.description: Daily updates on open-source automated research tools: commits, releases, and community activity.

item.title: Daily digest — 2026-08-03
item.description:
Our community has seen significant progress across multiple projects recently. Notably, the `scienceverse/metacheck` project has introduced dedicated import and export functionality for files, thanks to Lakens' updates. Meanwhile, `giladfeldman/docpluck` has addressed several issues, including a documentation and testing fix, and resolved glyph problems related to "efendic" headings. The `Davidvandijcke/coarse` project has enhanced security with a release audit fix and added "Buy Me a Coffee" funding links, while `JamieCummins/regcheck` has fixed multiple bugs, including a CLI issue and ad blocker interference. Additionally, `giladfeldman/escicheck` has synchronized with `effectcheck` version `0.6.14`, and `shaheedazaad/auto-zcurve` has made substantial updates, including an installer fix and a switch to a browser-based UI. These connections and advancements demonstrate the collaborative spirit and dedication of our community to improving open-source research tools.

30 commits across 5 active repositories this week.

New releases: auto-zcurve v0.11.1

Dormant repos revived: scrutiny, escicheck

item.title: auto-zcurve: 8 commits today
item.description:
shaheedazaad/auto-zcurve

The main branch was the focus of the recent work, with multiple commits addressing various aspects of the project. The R installer was fixed, as stated in two separate commits on August 3, with the messages "R installer fix" indicating that issues with the R installer were resolved. On August 2, several changes were made, including an "installer update", fixes for "windows compatibility issues" and "portability issues", and the implementation of an "extraction schema". Additionally, the project's "readme" was updated, and the project was "switched to browser-based UI", indicating a significant change in the user interface. The work on August 2 also laid the groundwork for the subsequent R installer fixes.
